messages:
sam (docs): kicking off a small docs PR to update streaming + pagination examples. intention: give teams copy-pasteable iterator-based snippets for py/ts/go, show a simple client retry pattern, and document resume-token tradeoffs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5200
lee (eng-runtime): awesome. can we add a short example showing AbortController for TS cancellation and context.WithTimeout for Go? many users ask about cancelling inflight streams.
maya (eng-ml): also recommend a one-line compatibility note about switching between quantized and fp models — we've observed a token-dup/truncate in some edge reconnections.
sam (docs): yes. plan is three minimal snippets:
- python: async for + exponential backoff wrapper 
- typescript: for-await-of + AbortController + optional resume_token param
- go: channel read + context timeout + reattach with resume token
frank (eng-platform): heads-up: snippet harness flagged a timeout in go sample earlier. snip CI link: https://ci.internal/snippets/6600. please add context timeout to go snippet and ensure filenames are kebab-case.
snippets-bot: snippet-harness: failed job `docs-examples` - examples/go/stream-resume-sample.go line 19 (context deadline exceeded)
sam (docs): added context.WithTimeout to go snippet and made filenames kebab-case. also added a tiny migration table mapping old callback hooks (on_chunk/on_error) to iterator equivalents.
lee (eng-runtime): left two small inline comments in the PR about KV cache wording and about the "resume token guarantees" paragraph. note: make it explicit that resume tokens are best-effort and not durable across model variant changes.
maya (eng-ml): added the quantization compatibility blurb in the PR body. also offered a mock test for the resume path that CI can run.
snippets-bot: snippet-harness: all checks passed on branch docs/iterator-examples-2026.
frank (eng-platform): added a CI note to tag the merge with `docs: streaming iterator examples` so SDK owners can sync.
sam (docs): thanks — merging in 15m unless objections. quick reminder added: "cost note" about long-lived streams still consuming tokens while open. final reviewers: @lee @maya @frank
lee (eng-runtime): lgtm.
maya (eng-ml): lgtm.
frank (eng-platform): lgtm. merging now. :tada:
